title: Embracing Anisotropy: Turning Massive Activations into Interpretable Control Knobs for Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper evaluates its proposed activation steering method (Critical Dimension Steering) across 57 subjects of the MMLU benchmark, which includes specific categories for 'World Religions', 'Business Ethics', and 'Moral Scenarios'. Additionally, it performs experiments on safety jailbreaking using AdvBench to evaluate the steering of refusal mechanisms.
